charts.title: Trevor Rogers: ERA vs xERA by season
charts.caption: His 2025 ERA ran well below his xERA. In 2026 his ERA was the higher of the two.
charts.alt: Grouped bar chart comparing Trevor Rogers' ERA and xERA in 2021, 2024, 2025 and 2026.

charts.title: Rogers' four-seam to changeup speed gap (mph)
charts.caption: The changeup is about two mph closer to his fastball than it was in 2021.
charts.alt: Line chart showing Rogers' fastball-to-changeup speed gap falling from 9.7 mph in 2021 to 6.8 mph in 2026.

charts.title: Rogers' changeup run value by season (runs)
charts.caption: Positive is good for the pitcher. Only one changeup in MLB cost more runs in 2026.
charts.alt: Bar chart of Rogers' changeup run value: +6 in 2021, -4 in 2024, +7 in 2025 and -11 in 2026.

charts.title: Rogers' 2026 pitch mix: through July vs Aug-Sep (%)
charts.caption: Over his last 10 starts he threw fewer changeups and more four-seamers and sweepers.
charts.alt: Grouped bar chart of Rogers' 2026 pitch usage through July compared with August and September.
